payload.title: P5 Saving writing guidelines updates the checks drawn from them
payload.description:
What: the writer and the checker read the same data.

Files:
- src/papyrus_content/guidelines/derived_policies.py: humanus.policy_pack_from_style_profile on the saved document; publication scope for the site document, desk scope for a section document; plan_policies / apply_plan from editorial_policy_pack.py
- source writing-guidelines:<slug>:v<N> on derived policies; only those are created, updated or disabled; an admin's edit of a derived policy sets source custom (editorial-checks panel save path: lib/editorial-checks-client.ts, components/editorial-checks-admin-panel.tsx)
- guidelines_diff includes the policy plan
- src/papyrus_content/editorial_commands.py: `editorial import --profile` points at `papyrus guidelines save --kind writing`
- features_backend/guidelines-derived-policies.feature

Acceptance checks:
- Saving a document with a new avoided word creates or updates exactly one derived policy.
- A starter-pack policy and a hand-written policy are untouched by any save.
- Removing a word disables the derived policy it produced (kept for history).

Gherkin scenarios:
- Saving site writing guidelines creates the checks drawn from them
- Saving section writing guidelines creates desk checks for that section
- A check an admin wrote is never changed by saving guidelines
- Editing a derived check by hand stops it being synced
- The diff shows check changes before anything is saved

Design: docs/plans/guidelines-as-data.md. Gherkin specs are required and ship in the same PR. Text lives in S3, never inline in DynamoDB; no new GSI; no subscriptions. Style and voice wording is data, never code.
